title: gateway: a change declares the metric it will move and is judged on it in prod; the island measures its own loop

labels.name: agent-fix
labels.description: Opt-in: this issue is fair game for the agent fixer

labels.name: agent/blocked
labels.description: Needs a human — budget escalate / max rounds / ambiguous

body:
A gateway change ships with no stated effect and nothing checks one afterwards. It deployed 28 times in 7 days through the auto-merged pin PR; the only net is the Degraded-revert chain.

**Wanted.** The oracle-fleet#1082 shape, without a rollout engine:
- a change that means to move a number says so before it is built: the PromQL, the pass threshold, the recorded baseline, the window and the minimum samples (oracle keeps these in `gateway/experiments/experiments.json`; its intake writes the block into the issue and backtests it over 14 days first);
- after the pin PR syncs, the claim is read on prod and the verdict (pass / fail / no verdict) lands where the issue's owner sees it; a fail re-opens the work, a pass closes it;
- the gateway names its own KPIs with targets, and the island's loop numbers — time from filing to queued, review rounds per PR, rides that ended without a record, time a queued item waits for dispatch — exist as series with targets, so a regression files work without a person noticing first.

Volume is the constraint: 200 sessions takes about 50 h on the anthropic rail, so claims count requests or wait longer than oracle's 6 h, and the thin rails are judged by fixed cases.

Prerequisites, filed alongside: the release named on `/healthz`; real and synthetic traffic separable; outcome alerts as guards. Oracle's claim loader, `release_observe.py` and backtest are close to generic — reuse is a question for the ruling, not a requirement.

**Done when:** one gateway change has carried a claim from its issue to a recorded verdict on prod.

Origin: operator, 2026-11-16 — "it needs to define and ship its own metrics and monitor + improve them"; the reference is oracle-fleet#1082, the first rollout here that declared the Prometheus metric it was going to improve. Ruled the same day: no Kargo for the gateway yet — the metrics come first, on the existing pin-PR deploy. Gateway island.
